test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

Has the proposal been reviewed by the advisory board yet?

options.text: Is the advisory board reviewing the proposal?
Did the advisory board review the proposal already?
Has the advisory board reviewed the proposal yet?
The proposal is under review by the advisory board.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Has the advisory board reviewed the proposal yet? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, where the subject (the proposal) receives the action of being reviewed by the advisory board.
 
• In the **active voice**, the subject (the advisory board) performs the action of reviewing the proposal.
 
• The correct transformation of the sentence maintains the tense (present perfect) and meaning, shifting the focus to the subject performing the action.

Correct sentence: *Has the advisory board reviewed the proposal yet?*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active voice:** The subject performs the action (e.g., "The advisory board reviewed the proposal").
 
• **Passive voice:** The subject receives the action (e.g., "The proposal was reviewed by the advisory board").
 
• **Present perfect tense:** Used to describe actions that happened at an unspecified time before now (e.g., "Has the advisory board reviewed...?").
